_note: Defaults. Personal overrides live in the private state repo, not here.

structure._note: Optional flex: up to `count` extra sessions beyond gym_max / bikes_min, in any of `sports`. optional=true means the athlete decides each week (e.g. skip when tired). prefer picks the sport by season phase (base, build, peak, taper, race_week, recovery; default otherwise). Set it as structure.flex in the profile's rule_overrides.

light_week._note: A week is lighter when it is reduction_pct_min below the highest of the compare_weeks weeks before it, so every low week after a race counts. While rebuilding (planned km below skip_while_below_peak_pct of the 12-week peak) no lighter week is asked for.

all_out.note: Races and all-out time trials need an easy week after and 4+ weeks between. Same-day multi-event races count once.

phases.note: Weeks before the next A race (counted from this Monday): race_week 0, taper <= taper_weeks, then peak, build, base. Recovery for the week after an A or B race.

execution._note: Session reviews (execution.py): a rep is on target within pace_tolerance_s of the range; a session is repeated when under complete_share of reps are done, half the reps are slow, the second half fades more than max_fade_s and ends slow, or HR drifts more than max_hr_drift bpm (reps of 3 min+, from rep 2). Two sessions in a row bias_s off the range in one direction raise a pace flag.

rolling._note: Rolling plan (docs/rolling-plan.md): what the Sunday job does with next week after its review. never: wait for the athlete (decide_proposal / publish_week or the app). unchanged: publish the week when the review changed nothing. minor: also approve and publish a small change (only easy runs, swims, bike, gym or the optional session changed, same days, run km within minor_km_pct). always: approve and publish every proposal. A week that breaks a coaching rule is never published automatically. watch_sports: the sports sent to the watch; the others (e.g. gym logged in Hevy) stay in the plan only. Set it in the profile's rule_overrides, e.g. {"rolling": {"auto_publish": "minor"}}.
